picks.name: Craftsmen
picks.blurb: Beer brewed on the premises by Thibault and Florian, poured a few hundred metres from the Bastille crowds and a world away from them in volume. Sharing boards to go with it, wine and alcohol-free options if beer is not your thing, and room for twenty to forty if you are taking over a corner. Opens at five, closes at one on Fridays and Saturdays.
picks.why: The 11th sends most visitors to rue de Lappe and Oberkampf. This is the same arrondissement, eight minutes' walk, and nobody is queueing.
